name: Vatar

investors: Abdulhamid 'AB' Hassan (lead), Nathan Nwachuku (lead), Resilience17 / GB Agboola (lead), Oo Nwoye
founder_or_marketing_contact: Shalom Rayhamen (Co-founder, CEO & CTO), Owen Rayhamen (Co-founder & CPO), Anderson Oriahi (Co-founder & CBDO); justina@vatar.com (partnerships); press@vatar.com; https://www.linkedin.com/company/vatarhq

pitch_hook: Vatar raised $500K on 2026-10-09 and touts 11M+ players, yet @vatarhq has only 37 IG followers, a stale 'digital human for businesses' bio, a 46-day gap before this week's posts, no blog, and no dedicated marketing/growth title on its team page.
